title: CLAUDE.md's promotion paragraph enumerated pull_request runs and stated a conclusion about runs on the SHA: main's landing commit DOES get a green push run
description:
MEASURED 2026-09-16 during the dev->main promotion that landed ccda1dd7.

CLAUDE.md's repository profile currently opens a paragraph with:

  **A promotion leaves no green run on the SHA that lands on `main`, and the only
  run there is a failing one.** ... Measured on the 2026-09-15 promotion: `main` is
  `e4b384b9`, whose only run (34996985802) is a failure ... An auditor who looks for
  a green run on `main`'s SHA will find a red one and conclude the promotion was
  unqualified.

Both the headline and the auditing advice are FALSE, and the falsification is a
direct enumeration rather than an inference:

  gh api "repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/actions/runs?head_sha=e4b384b92db59087eff27ea1eabfc5adc1c63225"
    34997754121  push          completed/cancelled  CI
    34996985802  pull_request  completed/failure    CI

TWO runs on that SHA, not one. The profile cites the pull_request one and calls it
"whose only run". The push run 34997754121 has EVERY substantive job green —
including `main is fast-forward of dev` — and carries the aggregate `cancelled`
only because `lint · typecheck · test (macos-latest)`, which is NOT a required
context on dev, was cancelled. The same shape holds for the promotion before it:
34999719292 on 41ac5a65, same single cancelled macos job, everything else green.

Today's promotion removes the last ambiguity. Push run 35155792741 on ccda1dd7 is
`completed/success` across all 15 jobs, `main is fast-forward of dev` among them.
There is now unambiguously a green run on the SHA that landed on `main`.

WHY THE ERROR HAPPENED, which is the part worth keeping. The object measured was
"runs reachable from the promotion PR"; the object the claim is about is "runs on
that SHA". Those differ by exactly the push-event run, because `push:` on ci.yml
is `branches: [main]` (LCLI-251 dropped dev) — so main's landing commit is the ONE
commit in this repo that gets BOTH a pull_request run and a push run. This is the
failure mode the profile's own neighbouring paragraph names ("Name the object you
measured and the object your claim is about, and confirm they are the same one").
It went unnoticed because `gh run list` without `--event` shows the newest run and
reads like the only one.

CONSEQUENCE IF LEFT: inverted auditing advice. The profile tells the next session
that an auditor will find a red run and wrongly conclude the promotion was
unqualified; the actual risk is now the opposite — a green push run exists, and a
session that has been told "the only run there is a failing one" may not look for
it, or may mistrust it when it appears.

WHAT STAYS TRUE and must not be lost in the edit:
- CI does not run on pushes to `dev` (LCLI-251), so a dev squash commit has no run.
- The promotion PR's run DOES necessarily contain `promotion is manual` failing by
  design, and that is not a qualification failure. Confirmed again today: run
  35155304664's only red job is that guard.
- The gating evidence still lives on the PR head that merged into `dev`
  (35030927529 on 02deee37 for this promotion), and that is still what to cite.
- A docs-only push to main triggers no push run at all (paths-ignore covers
  `**/*.md`, `docs/**`, `backlog/**`, `.claude/**`), so the green push run is
  conditional on the promotion touching non-ignored paths. An edit that promises
  a green push run unconditionally would just be the same error mirrored.
- `main` still has no ruleset (`rules/branches/main` returns `[]` — re-read
  2026-09-16), so a green push run is evidence, NOT an enforced gate. The honest
  phrasing for a promotion stays "no checks are configured on main".

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CLAUDE.md paragraph no longer claims the landing SHA has only one run or only a failing one, and states that the SHA receives both a pull_request run and a push run because ci.yml push is branches:[main]

The replacement text is anchored to re-resolvable evidence: the head_sha API query form, and run ids on at least two distinct promotions (34996985802 + 34997754121 on e4b384b9; 35155304664 + 35155792741 on ccda1dd7)

The four facts that remain true are preserved: no run on dev squash commits (LCLI-251), promotion-is-manual red by design, gating evidence cited from the dev-side PR head, and main having no ruleset so a green push run is evidence rather than an enforced gate
The paths-ignore caveat is stated, so the green push run is not promised unconditionally for a docs-only promotion
lore check exits 0 and the Tracker integrity job passes on the delivering PR

finalSummary:
Delivered in PR #124, qualified by run 35156727144 on f7c21b3c (completed/success; all twelve substantive jobs green, both promotion guards correctly `skipping` because the PR targets dev). Cited by PR and run rather than squash SHA.

WHAT CHANGED. CLAUDE.md's profile claimed the SHA landing on `main` has one run and that it is a failure, and told the next session an auditor would find a red run and wrongly call the promotion unqualified. Enumerating runs by head_sha falsifies it: e4b384b9 carries 34997754121 (push) AND 34996985802 (pull_request). The paragraph cited the second and called it the only one. The push run was green on every substantive job including `main is fast-forward of dev`, carrying `cancelled` only from the non-required macos-latest job.

ROOT CAUSE, which is the reusable part. The object measured was "runs reachable from the promotion PR"; the object claimed was "runs on that SHA". They differ by exactly the push-event run, because ci.yml's `push:` is `branches: [main]` — main's landing commit is the only commit here that gets both events. `gh run list` without `--event` returns the newest and reads like the only one. This is precisely the failure the imported fleet block's "name the object you measured" paragraph exists to name, committed in the profile that imports it.

THE FIX SHAPE MATTERS MORE THAN THE FACT. The paragraph now carries the head_sha QUERY rather than its conclusion, so the next reader re-resolves instead of trusting. Two self-corrections during the work, both found by running rather than reasoning: (1) the first draft said "TWO runs" flatly, but the query is repository-wide and a promotion makes dev and main the same commit, so upstream-backlog-watch.yml's scheduled run appears as a third unrelated green — the claim is now scoped to ci.yml and names the third run; (2) the cross-reference pointed "below" at a paragraph that lives in the imported fleet file, above the profile, not in CLAUDE.md at all. The snippet was extracted from the committed file and executed verbatim; its output is what the prose claims.

PRESERVED DELIBERATELY: no run on dev squash commits (LCLI-251); `promotion is manual` red by design; gating evidence still cited from the dev-side PR head; `rules/branches/main` still returns [] so a green push run is EVIDENCE, not enforcement; and the paths-ignore caveat, so a docs-only promotion is not promised a push run it never gets.

CONTEXT: found during the 2026-09-16 dev->main promotion (main 41ac5a65 -> ccda1dd7), whose own push run 35155792741 was success across all fifteen jobs — the observation that contradicted the profile. opum-agent independently re-resolved the same PR-vs-push split on its own promotion SHA 51dc433 and confirmed its profile does not carry the inverted claim.

Gates resolved with lore 0.7.0 and quest 0.7.1: `lore check` exit 0 (79 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings), `quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude` state: current.
